heading: Great Lakes material disposal
lead: In planning and implementing any navigation project (including maintenance thereof) on the Great Lakes and adjacent waters, the Secretary shall consult and cooperate with concerned States in selecting disposal areas for dredged material which is suitable for beach nourishment.

notes.text: “Secretary” Defined Secretary means the Secretary of the Army, see section 2201 of this title.

ancestors.heading: PROTECTION OF NAVIGABLE WATERS AND OF HARBOR AND RIVER IMPROVEMENTS GENERALLY
